Messages.Author: wedge
Messages.Body:
If the action card I play during another Meths turn gets DI'ed can I
still take an action?
I am assuming the Cog is still tapped. It is a timing question.

Enkil Cog
Requires a vampire of capacity 10 or more. Unique. Only usable when
this vampire successfully bleeds your prey (play after resolution).
Put this card on this vampire. During any Methuselah`s minion phase,
this vampire may tap this card to attempt an action. This vampire has
+1 bleed.

Matt

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The Cog is still tapped, but as the vampire hasn't yet attempted an action (the
canceled action card's action isn't attempted), you can still attempt an action.

Or you may choose not to (since there is no default action) and let the Cog's
"attempt action" effect fizzle.

Messages.Author: wedge
Messages.Body:


That is what I thought.

Thank you

1/ You tap the EC to attempt an action. The action must be announced
(and the card played) at the same time you tap the EC, right?
2/ Are those two effects (tapping the EC and attempting the action by
playing the card) bound ?
3/ Was is the difference with a PB: Tshwane which is not tapped if the
action is canceled?
4/ And another question : is the text of PB: Tshwane saying that the
location is not tapped a remainder or a specific effect for the PB?

Name: Powerbase: Tshwane
[LoB:R]
Cardtype: Master
Master: unique location. Requires a ready Laibon.
Tap this location to reduce the cost of a card you play by 1 pool
(this location is not tapped if that card is canceled as it is
played). Any Laibon may steal this location for his or her controller
as a (D) action.
